entries.title: Proverbs 9:1
segments: Wisdom hath builded her house; She hath hewn out her seven pillars:

entries.title: Proverbs 9:2
segments: She hath killed her beasts; She hath mingled her wine; She hath also furnished her table:

entries.title: Proverbs 9:3
segments: She hath sent forth her maidens; She crieth upon the highest places of the city:

entries.title: Proverbs 9:4
segments: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: As for him that is void of understanding, she saith to him,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:5
segments: Come, eat ye of my bread, And drink of the wine which I have mingled.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:6
segments: Leave off, ye simple ones, and live; And walk in the way of understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:7
segments: He that correcteth a scoffer getteth to himself reviling; And he that reproveth a wicked man [getteth] himself a blot.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:8
segments: Reprove not a scoffer, lest he hate thee: Reprove a wise man, and he will love thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:9
segments: Give [instruction] to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: Teach a righteous man, and he will increase in learning.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:10
segments: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; And the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:11
segments: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, And the years of thy life shall be increased.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:12
segments: If thou art wise, thou art wise for thyself; And if thou scoffest, thou alone shalt bear it.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:13
segments: The foolish woman is clamorous; [She is] simple, and knoweth nothing.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:14
segments: And she sitteth at the door of her house, On a seat in the high places of the city,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:15
segments: To call to them that pass by, Who go right on their ways:

entries.title: Proverbs 9:16
segments: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither; And as for him that is void of understanding, she saith to him,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:17
segments: Stolen waters are sweet, And bread [eaten] in secret is pleasant.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:18
segments: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; That her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
